Market today: The market mood for tech/chips is mixed. While some scanner setups show short-term bullish bias, rising Treasury yields and concerns about increasing leverage in the AI infrastructure boom are key drivers. This could put pressure on your growth-heavy, margin-fueled portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-42.88%) and SPAL (-38.21%) need immediate attention. Both are leveraged ETFs, decay over time, and are showing significant losses. Trading on margin amplifies these drops, making them extra painful. Review their stops carefully.

Watch: Keep an eye on Treasury yields; continued rises could pressure your tech names. Also, monitor any news regarding leverage in the AI sector, as this directly impacts your core holdings.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your deeply underwater leveraged positions, especially with broader market headwinds emerging.
plays: Review stops on SOXL and SPAL. Given deep losses (-42.88%, -38.21%) and leveraged nature, consider trimming to reduce risk exposure.
Consider adding to QQQ. Scanner suggests "ACCUMULATE" at 731.34-730.61 with a stop at 728.77.
NVDA shows a "BUY" setup at 225.07-224.85, stop 224.51. Consider this as a new position if you want more chip exposure.
